dialogues.interceptPart1:
Oh, <PLAYER>! Our
neighbor, PROF.

ELM, was looking
for you.

He said he wanted
you to do some'r
thing for him.

Oh! I almost for'r
got! Your BUDDYMON

GEAR is back from
the repair shop.

Here you go!
BUDDYMON GEAR, or
just BUDDYGEAR.

It's essential if
you want to be a
good trainer.

Oh, the day of the
week isn't set.

You mustn't forget
that!
Is it Daylight
Saving Time now'v
Come home to
adjust your clock

for Daylight
Savi
dialogues.buddygearPart2: BUDDYMON GEAR, or just BUDDYGEAR. It's essential if you want to be a good trainer. Oh, the day of the week isn't set. You mustn't forget that!
dialogues.phonePart3: Phone numbers are stored in memory. Just choose a name you want to call. Gee, isn't that convenient?
dialogues.waitingForElm: PROF. ELM is waiting for you. Hurry up, baby!
dialogues.afterElm: So, what was PROF. ELM's errand? …That does sound challenging. But, you should be proud that people rely on you! <PLAYER>, do it! I'm behind you all the way!

dialogues.daughterStory: <PLAYER>, have you heard? My daughter is adamant about becoming PROF. ELM's assistant. She really loves BUDDYMON!

signposts.text: The sink is spotless. Mom likes it clean.
Let's see what's in the fridge… FRESH WATER and tasty LEMONADE!

A collection of cookbooks, home decor magazines, and Buddymon care guides.
A cozy dining table with a freshly brewed pot of berry tea and two cups.
